A US ring size is determined by measuring the inner diameter or circumference of your finger in millimeters.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/ring-size-chart/)[[2]](https://us.pandora.net/en/guide-size-rings/guide-size-rings.html)

### US Ring Size Chart (Circumference & Diameter)

| US Size | Inner Circumference (mm) | Inner Diameter (mm) |
|---|---|---|
| **4** | 46.8 mm | 14.9 mm |
| **5** | 49.3 mm | 15.7 mm |
| **6** | 51.9 mm | 16.5 mm |
| **7** | 54.4 mm | 17.3 mm |
| **8** | 57.0 mm | 18.2 mm |
| **9** | 59.5 mm | 19.0 mm |
| **10** | 62.1 mm | 19.8 mm |
| **11** | 64.6 mm | 20.6 mm |
| **12** | 67.2 mm | 21.4 mm |
| **13** | 69.7 mm | 22.2 mm |

### How to Measure at Home

- **String or Paper Method:** Wrap a thin strip of paper or string snugly around the base of your finger.[[1]](https://www.vancleefarpels.com/content/dam/vancleefarpels/pdf-guides/size-guides/size-guide-ring/van-cleef-arpels-ring-size-guide-en.pdf)[[2]](https://mejuri.com/ca/en/how-to/sizing/ring-sizing-101)
- **Mark and Measure:** Mark the spot where the paper or string overlaps. Lay it flat on a ruler and measure the length in millimeters to find your circumference.[[1]](https://www.tiffany.com/client-services/size-guide.html)[[2]](https://vitalycustomersupport.gorgias.help/en-US/ring-sizing-119012)[[3]](https://mejuri.com/ca/en/how-to/sizing/ring-sizing-101)
- **Rule of Thumb:** If your measurement falls between two sizes, always **round up** to the larger size.[[1]](https://vitalycustomersupport.gorgias.help/en-US/ring-sizing-119012)[[2]](https://www.tiffany.com/client-services/size-guide.html)
- **Band Width:** Wider bands fit tighter; you may need to go up a half size for thick rings. You can also print a physical tool like the [Macy's Ring Sizer](https://www.macys.com/media/ring_sizer/ring_sizer.pdf) or the [David Yurman Ring Size Guide](https://www.davidyurman.com/world-of-yurman/stories/guides/ring-size-chart-and-guide.html) for more precise at-home measuring.[[1]](https://ucffoundation.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/Ring-Size.pdf)[[2]](https://www.macys.com/media/ring_sizer/ring_sizer.pdf)[[3]](https://www.davidyurman.com/world-of-yurman/stories/guides/ring-size-chart-and-guide.html)

If you'd like, tell me:

- **Who** the ring is for (men's or women's average size)
- **Which finger** you are measuring (left or right hand)
- **The measurement** you got in millimeters

I can help you find your exact size and check if you need to adjust for a wide band.
